title: plugyard scenario file
description: A scenario: timed actions carried out against a running site.

steps.description: The steps, written in the order they run.

at.description: When the step runs, counted from the start of the run: 0s, 30s, 10m, 1h30m. Times follow the site's speed.

charger.description: A charge point ID, a charger's name, or a pattern such as "FAST-*".

do.description: The action: one of the actions of "plugyard exec", or stop, start, restart or kill.

connector.description: The connector number. Default 1. For fault and clear, 0 means the charger as a whole.

tag.description: tap: the tag presented. At most 20 characters.

ev.description: plug: an EV preset of the site file.

soc.description: plug: state of charge at plug-in, such as 20%.

maxPower.description: plug: the most power the EV accepts, such as 11kW.

targetSoc.description: plug: state of charge at which the EV stops, such as 80%.

info.description: fault: free text about the fault. At most 50 characters.

vendorCode.description: fault: the vendor's own code for the fault. At most 50 characters.

for.description: offline: come back online after this long, such as 30s. Without it the charger stays offline until an online step.

step.description: fail: what fails next. download and install belong to a firmware update, upload to a diagnostics upload.
